policy: Promote only after canonical stable_ready, complete CI gates, native Qt Wayland proof, stable desktop validation and deterministic double packaging.

retry_after_quality_refactor.policy: Run the complete fail-closed Stable workflow on the exact source commit; do not bypass any gate.

retry_after_coverage_scope_fix.reason: Stable finalizer exposed UI-only Qt/canonical modules inside the core coverage denominator after UI extraction.
retry_after_coverage_scope_fix.policy: Keep 80/65 thresholds unchanged; exclude only presentation-layer modules already outside the intended core coverage contract.

retry_after_verify_launch_fix.reason: Stable finalizer attempted to execute verify_release.sh directly although the tracked Git mode is 100644.
retry_after_verify_launch_fix.policy: Invoke the existing verification contract explicitly through bash; do not weaken or skip verification.

retry_after_gui_roundtrip_timeout.reason: The previous Stable finalizer passed 600 tests and the 80/65 coverage contract, then exhausted the 120-minute workflow budget in a nested xvfb-run GUI roundtrip despite an already active X11 display.
retry_after_gui_roundtrip_timeout.policy: Keep the GUI roundtrip mandatory; reuse the existing DISPLAY when present and enforce a 180-second fail-closed timeout.
